text: The ordinal proof-theoretic analysis of a theory T gives:
choices: the cardinality of the set of proofs
the smallest ordinal not provably total in T
the consistency strength expressed as a specific ordinal (the proof-theoretic ordinal of T)
explanation: The proof-theoretic ordinal |T| is the supremum of ordinals α for which T proves the well-foundedness of a recursive well-ordering of order type α. |PA|=ε₀.
